name: Rectory (presbytere)
description: Village presbytery, 15 x 11 m: a symmetrical rendered front with dressed-stone quoins, string course and cornice under a slate hip roof with three dormers and two chimneys, a stone door case with pilasters and a pediment, shuttered windows. Study, hall and dining room; three rooms above; two stairs; ivy.

steps.note: core A: level 0 up to the half landing
core B: level 1 down to the half landing
